Read the table of parameters to calibrate for each functional group

read_parameter_table.Rd

Reads the parameter table, which has one row per functional group and one column per calibration parameter, with 1 if the parameter is calibrated for that group and 0 if not. Parameter column names are matched without regard to case or surrounding spaces and renamed to mum, BHalpha, BHbeta, KDENR, mfc, mQ, mL, C and E.

Usage

read_parameter_table(parameter.file)

Arguments

parameter.file

Character. Name of the parameter table CSV file in inputs. Must contain a Code column and one or more parameter columns. Optional columns: GroupType, IsTurnedOn and IsCalibrated.

Value

A data frame with column Code, any of the optional columns present, and one column per parameter in the table.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
  param.table <- read_parameter_table("parameter_table.csv")
} # }
